signal: Filevine raised $400M across two rounds and launched its Legal Operating Intelligence System (LOIS), deploying AI agents across firm documents and case files.

email.body1:
Nate, saw Filevine raised 400M dollars and launched the Legal Operating Intelligence System with AI agents across case files.

Scaling that fast usually means signals fire faster than ops can route them into action, and good accounts go cold in the gap. Our AI SDR turns a signal into a researched, personalized, logged touch with zero rep time: 3-5x more meetings per rep, same team.

I built a personalized signal play for Filevine off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress around 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Nate, quick follow-up for Filevine.

Post-raise, the biggest measurable leak in sales ops is usually time between a signal firing and a rep acting on it, plus the data hygiene that eats cycles. Tightening that is where lift hides: our best practices alone tend to raise reply rates 50 to 70 percent.

Worth 15 minutes? I'll walk you through a teardown of your current outbound and three things I'd change to cut that latency.
email.body3:
Nate, last bit of proof for Filevine.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to 2.7M dollars in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Filevine's reply rate likely compares to other legal tech companies. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Nate, I'll stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If cutting signal-to-action latency without adding headcount isn't a priority right after the raise, no problem at all. Timing is everything post-funding, and I know that stretch keeps ops busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your ops motion? I'll tailor it to Filevine either way.
